Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Denominations and Characteristics of Coins
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 22nd June 2011 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE

The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2011” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’clock of the coin.
The set features10 orchids as named below:
(a)Vanda Tan Chay Yan
(b)Aranda Majula
(c)Dendrobium Singa Mas
(d)Vanda Mimi Palmer
(e)Aranda Tay Swee Eng
(f)Oncidium Goldiana
(g)Spathoglottis Primrose
(h)Vanda Amy
(i)Aranthera Anne Black
(j)Aranda Noorah Alsagoff
In each design, the orchid is featured in full colour at the centre with its name around the upper circumference. The fineness of the coin is around the left circumference and the denomination is below the orchid. Contours of the orchid are depicted at the bottom of the coin.
